subject: Partial checkout outage on Dec 8 — request for remediation & evidence
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@orbitalcommerce.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partial checkout outage impacting US-WEST customers — remediation + credit request

Hi Sean,

We saw a significant availability problem across checkout flows for Orbital Commerce customers between ~14:03 and 14:35 UTC on Dec 8. Rough timeline and impact we observed: 
- 14:03 UTC: spike in 500/503 responses from Redwood API calls (checkout/generate).
- 14:05–14:20 UTC: elevated latencies (p95 up from ~120ms to 1.2s), several client-side retries triggered.
- 14:20–14:35 UTC: sustained 5xx rate (~8% of requests).
- Total customer-visible downtime window we measured: ~32 minutes.

This directly affected payment completion on our site for ~9% of sessions during the window. Payment provider needed manual intervention for some orders. We have attached a short CSV (orbital-impact-summary.csv) showing request timestamps and sample request IDs.

Can you please confirm Redwood’s observed outage window, provide the initial cause if available, and confirm whether this qualifies for an SLA credit (and if so, the calculation approach)? We’ll also need raw trace bundles and any per-tenant request logs (or a pointer where your team will upload them).

We’re trying to scope customer impact for an internal incident report and our CS/ops teams will need a timeline and proposed remediation/compensation ASAP.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Platform Operations
Orbital Commerce
attachments: orbital-impact-summary.csv (CSV, 78KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@orbitalcommerce.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partial checkout outage impacting US-WEST customers — remediation + credit request

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and the CSV, that’s helpful. 

Immediate next steps from our side: 
- We’re pulling the raw trace bundle for your tenant from us-west-2 for the 14:00–14:45 UTC window and will upload a redacted archive.
- Diego will run a first-pass to validate whether the 5xxs are server-side (our infra) or due to downstream auth/payment latency.
- Priyom will start a timeline draft for a postmortem and a recommended remediation/compensation path.

Prelim note: our monitoring shows a routing blip and an elevated KV cache eviction rate in unavailable nodes in the us-west-2 cluster around that time. We need to confirm correlation vs causation. I’ll get you an initial impact confirmation by EOD tomorrow (Dec 9) and a proposed credit calculation shortly after.

I’m looping in Laura to coordinate the SLA/contract side and get you a single point of contact for the remediation offer.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll treat this as high priority.

Best,
Sean
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
attachments: (we’ll upload raw_traces_usw2_20261208.tar.gz and an initial impact spreadsheet)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: OC outage — evidence pull, RCA scope, and customer comms

Team — internal thread to coordinate evidence and customer-facing timeline. Alex has provided an impact CSV; they report ~32 minutes of customer-visible failure.

Ask list:
1) Diego: full trace extraction from us-west-2 for tenant orbitalcommerce (14:00–14:45 UTC). Include kvcache metrics, routing table snapshots, and per-instance CPU/GPU utilization. Please redacted PII before upload.
2) Priyom: draft a brief timeline (bullet form) for customer comms + an initial estimate of SLA credit eligibility. Use the standard SLO calculation (minutes of downtime / 30-day minutes * monthly invoice) as a starting point — we’ll refine after the telemetry hash.
3) Laura: confirm contract terms for Orbital Commerce (tier, SLO target, blackout windows, any contractual exemptions). Also prep a provisional remediation offer we can present to Alex (one-liner + next steps).

Preliminary notes from monitoring: we observed a KF eviction cascade in a small subset of instances and a short routing reconfiguration that caused a subset of requests to be routed to a lower-capacity shard which degraded p95. KV eviction + routing cold starts is our working hypothesis. Diego, prioritize traces that show: kv eviction counts, shard reassignments, and instance restart events.

Timeline for external update: I’ll send an acknowledgement with ETA tonight (EOD PST). Target: proposed remediation and evidence bundle by EOD Dec 10, with a postmortem meeting scheduled within 72 hours of final impact confirmation.

–Sean

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Internal: OC outage — evidence pull, RCA scope, and customer comms

Quick update after initial triage (attached: raw_traces_usw2_20261208.tar.gz and rca-draft.md):

Findings (first pass):
- Confirmed elevated KV cache eviction rates on 4 instances in us-west-2 from 14:02:10–14:36:45 UTC.
- Routing flapping detected during the same window; a small percentage of requests were routed to a fallback shard with higher tokenization latency.
- No evidence of downstream payment gateway failures in Redwood telemetry (we requested their logs via Alex).

Impact assessment:
- Using our per-tenant telemetry and the supplied orbital-impact-summary.csv, we estimate ~28–34 minutes of effective customer impact.
- Based on contract SLO (99.95% monthly availability) and standard pro-rata approach, the incident appears provisionally eligible for a credit. Exact credit amount requires final confirmation of total downtime minutes across the billing period.

Proposed remediation/offer to present to customer (one-liner):
- "We apologize for the disruption. Our investigation shows a cache-eviction-triggered routing fallback in us-west-2 on Dec 8; we will provide a full RCA within 72 hours and apply a pro-rata invoice credit for the confirmed downtime. In parallel, we will schedule a live postmortem and propose a mitigation plan to reduce eviction-induced routing churn."

Next steps (owner):
- Diego to upload redacted raw_traces_usw2_20261208.tar.gz to the shared drive link and flag any suspicious instance restarts (due EOD today).
- Priyom to compute provisional credit numbers using the 28–34 minute estimate and our billing formulas; prepare a short table showing credit scenarios (due EOD today).
- Sean to send the customer-facing acknowledgement and remediation offer once we have the provisional credit numbers.

I’ll attach the draft RCA (rca-draft.md) and the trace bundle to the Drive folder indicated in the related_links.

Laura Bennett
Director, Contracts & Customer Success
Redwood Inference
attachments: raw_traces_usw2_20261208.tar.gz (redacted trace bundle), rca-draft.md (8KB)
